clips.title: The story
paras: In Brill, Junior Apothecary Holland seeks doom weed for his research. The plant grows near Tirisfal's northern mass graves, where Rot Hide gnolls prowl.

Junior Apothecary Holland researches for the Royal Apothecary Society from Brill. He wants doom weed to advance his experiments, but Gordo cannot tell the right plants from the wrong ones. Holland turns to more capable hands to gather what he needs.

Doom weed grows thick around the mass gravesite just north of the Brill graveyard, where death and plague have tainted the soil. Rot Hide gnolls prowl the burial mounds, scavenging among the remains and guarding the overgrown trenches.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: So you can see the predicament that I'm in, friend. That thing is out there collecting the wrong weeds! I'll make it worth your while to gather what I need. Bring back to me enough doom weed and I'll give you a suitable reward.
It is my understanding that they like to plague the flora near the mass gravesite, to the north of the Brill graveyard. Hurry and be mindful of the gnolls in the area.

clips.title: Progress
paras: This had better be good. I trust you have all of the doom weed that I require?

clips.title: Completion
paras: These will come in quite handy. You've done me, uh, the Lady, a fine service today, friend. As promised here is the reward that you deserve.
